name: Teen Counseling
one_liner: BetterHelp's online therapy for teens 13–19: a licensed therapist by messaging, phone or video, with parent consent, paid by subscription.
best_for: Teens 13–19 with stress, anxiety or low mood who would rather message or talk from home

short_description: BetterHelp's teen therapy service: a licensed therapist by messaging, phone or video for ages 13–19, self-pay with parent consent.
long_description: Teen Counseling is run by BetterHelp for young people aged 13 to 19. A parent or guardian gives consent, the teen is matched with a licensed therapist, and they talk by messaging, phone or video in a private room parents can't read; parents can have a separate chat with the therapist. Teen Counseling's FAQ lists the price as $60 to $90 a week, billed every four weeks, depending on location and therapist availability; some recent reviews report $70 to $100 a week. It does not bill insurance and therapists do not prescribe medication. The FTC's 2023 order against BetterHelp names Teen Counseling as one of its brands; the FTC said sign-up promises that email addresses would never be shared were broken, and the order bans sharing health data for advertising. No published study of Teen Counseling itself was found.
patient_summary: A parent signs up and consents, then the teen is matched with a licensed therapist and talks with them by messaging, phone or video in a private room parents can't read. It's self-pay, listed at $60–$90 a week billed every four weeks, with no insurance and no medication.

pricing.notes: Price set after sign-up and depends on location, preferences and therapist availability; some 2026 reviews report $70–$100/week. Financial aid may be available. Not covered by insurance, Medicare or Medicaid.

basis.regulatory_action: FTC order, 2023 (BetterHelp, including Teen Counseling): shared email addresses and health information with advertisers despite promises not to; $7.8 million in refunds and a ban on sharing health data for ads

privacy.notes: The policy treats targeted-advertising disclosure as a 'sale' and uses ad cookies if you opt in; the 2023 FTC order against BetterHelp names Teen Counseling and bans sharing health data for ads.

seo.title: Teen Counseling: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Teen Counseling is BetterHelp's online therapy service for teens aged 13–19, with a licensed therapist by text, phone or video and parent consent.

faqs.q: How much does Teen Counseling cost?
faqs.a: About $70–$100/week, billed every 4 weeks. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Teen Counseling before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Teen Counseling replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Teen Counseling connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Teen Counseling?
faqs.a: Teen Counseling is available on iPhone, Android and the web.
Licensed therapists; Messaging, phone and video; Private teen room; Separate parent chat.
